title: testOS Run Intent
description: Cryptographic association contract between the host planner and the testOS runner. The host writes run-intent.json to the USB before boot; testOS reads it on boot, refuses to run if it is missing/malformed/stale/dry-run/inconsistent, and copies every field into manifest.json so the evidence validator can re-bind the run to the plan, catalog, image, source commit, and run_id. Schema version is frozen at 1; future versions must bump and the runner must refuse mismatched versions.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Frozen at 1; future versions must bump and the runner must refuse mismatched versions.

intent_kind.description: Discriminator field so the runner can confirm it is reading the right file type.

run_id.description: Stable run identifier shared by the host checkpoint and the testOS manifest. Must not be empty, must not contain path separators or whitespace, 4-128 chars.

source_commit.description: The 40-character git commit SHA the testOS image was built from. The runner records this in manifest.json (not merely prints it) and the validator re-checks it against the repo.

source_version.description: The Rush Linux project version this evidence certifies (e.g. '0.7.0-beta.4'). Must match the VERSION file.

testos_version.description: The testOS image version (from /etc/testos/version inside the image). The runner cross-checks this against the running image and refuses on mismatch.

testos_image_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the testOS image file the host wrote to the USB, prefixed with 'sha256:'. Binds the run to the exact image bytes.

testos_image_commit.description: REQUIRED (corrective-2 F4): the full 40-char git commit SHA the testOS image was built from (baked into the image at build time as /etc/testos/source-sha). SEPARATE from source_commit (the host-workflow commit). The runner cross-checks this against /etc/testos/source-sha and fails closed on mismatch. The validator verifies it exists in git.

plan_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the plan.json bytes the host generated. The runner records the plan alongside the results and the validator re-hashes it.

benchmark_catalog_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bench-list.toml bytes baked into the image. Binds the run to the exact benchmark catalog.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the host generated this intent. The runner rejects intents older than the freshness window (default 24h) to prevent stale-USB replays.

dry_run.description: If true, this is a dry-run intent. The runner refuses to execute a physical benchmark run when dry_run=true; only --dry-run planning paths may set this.

checkpoint_nonce.description: Campaign identity / checkpoint nonce. The host persists this in its checkpoint under LOCALAPPDATA (Windows) or ~/.rush (Linux); the runner copies it into manifest.json so the resume step can confirm the USB matches the checkpoint that launched it.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign identity grouping several runs. If absent, checkpoint_nonce is the sole campaign identity.

freshness_seconds.description: Optional maximum age in seconds for generated_at to be considered fresh. Defaults to 86400 (24h) if absent.

operator.description: Optional: name or handle of the operator who launched the run.
